Name: Basic Cape and Oversized Hood for Fashion Sense
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3Ffvnd3.png[/img]

[center]Worried you're not suspicious enough wandering around town at midnight?
Is your cult not cultish enough?
Well look no further!
This cape is perfect for adventurers, witches and wizards, and adding a bit of ominous mysteriousness to your definitely not suspicious activities.[/center]

[center]Adds a basic cape and oversized hood to the Fashion Sense menu. The cape is under Accessories, and the hood is under Hats.
Both items are colorable, and can be worn separately or together.

My [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28366]Short Hairstyles[/url]﻿ mod works well with the hood, and other short hairstyles may work well too!



[img]https://i.imgur.com/B92L7co.png[/img]
﻿Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿﻿!
Unzip the file and drop the folder, [FS] Luny's Basic Cape & Hood, into your StardewValley/mods folder.
It'll now appear in the Fashion Sense menu.﻿[/center]
